Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.jdbc

Class DriverManagerDataSource

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.jdbc.DriverManagerDataSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Wrapper, CommonDataSource, DataSource
public final class DriverManagerDataSource extends Object implements DataSource
A data source that opens a new connection through DriverManager on every call.

The user and password are passed to the driver as properties and are never written into the URL. toString() shows the URL with its secrets masked (user info and password, passwd and pwd parameters) and omits the password field. The JDBC driver must be on the classpath and registered the usual way.

There is no pooling: each getConnection() opens a physical connection that the caller must close. A server that needs a pool supplies its own DataSource instead. Instances are immutable and safe to share between threads.
